title: Clearer buffered SOE reporting
summary: ARSAS 1.6.44 makes historical IEC 61850 BRCB events easier to distinguish from live changes and integrity reports. It also hardens reconnect handling and protects retained IED buffer history. Field-checked on SG7_BCU; complete SOE recovery is not claimed.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.44 membantu membedakan event historis BRCB IEC 61850 dari perubahan live dan laporan integrity. Reconnect lebih andal dan riwayat buffer IED tetap terlindungi. Sudah diuji pada SG7_BCU; kelengkapan seluruh SOE belum diklaim.
highlights: Historical BRCB reports can be shown as “Buffer event” when wire EntryID, report reason and six-byte MMS BinaryTime support the classification.
Event Log keeps Buffer event, Data change and Integrity clearly separated instead of presenting every report as a live change.
Reconnect safeguards avoid overlapping monitor starts and stale or duplicated live-value rows.
Accepted EntryIDs cannot be reclassified as fresh buffered events after reconnect.
SG7_BCU field retest showed 77/77 live values, report ingress on 4/4 RCBs, 337 decoded frames and verified buffered classification on BrcbA01/BrcbB01.
highlightsId: Report historis BRCB dapat ditampilkan sebagai “Buffer event” jika EntryID, reason dan MMS BinaryTime 6-byte mendukung klasifikasinya.
Event Log membedakan Buffer event, Data change dan Integrity sehingga report historis tidak disamakan dengan perubahan live.
Reconnect lebih aman dari monitor Start yang bertumpuk dan baris nilai live yang usang atau ganda.
EntryID yang sudah diterima tidak dapat diklasifikasikan ulang sebagai event buffer baru saat reconnect.
Retest SG7_BCU menunjukkan 77/77 nilai live, report dari 4/4 RCB, 337 frame terdekode, serta klasifikasi buffer yang terbukti pada BrcbA01/BrcbB01.
improvements: Automatic BRCB monitoring preserves device history: no background PurgeBuf, destructive buffer reset or forced takeover of occupied RCBs.
Manual PurgeBuf is available only through the guarded IED Browser workflow with stopped monitoring, a suitable idle BRCB and explicit typed confirmation.
Report metadata retains original EntryID, TimeOfEntry, reason and ConfRev for traceable event interpretation.
Installer and portable single EXE are distributed from the same v1.6.44 release with published SHA-256 checksums, SPDX SBOM and provenance.
improvementsId: Monitoring BRCB otomatis menjaga riwayat perangkat: tanpa PurgeBuf di belakang layar, reset buffer destruktif atau mengambil alih RCB yang sedang dipakai.
PurgeBuf manual hanya tersedia melalui IED Browser dengan monitoring berhenti, BRCB idle yang sesuai dan konfirmasi ketik secara eksplisit.
Metadata report mempertahankan EntryID, TimeOfEntry, reason dan ConfRev asli agar interpretasi event dapat ditelusuri.
Installer dan portable single EXE tersedia dari rilis v1.6.44 yang sama beserta checksum SHA-256, SPDX SBOM dan provenance.
knownLimitations: The SG7_BCU trace also recorded 4 BufOvfl indications and 28 SqNum discontinuities. These are not verified lost-event counts; lossless buffered SOE is not established.
Six-byte MMS BinaryTime has no clock-synchronization quality byte. Buffer classification uses corroborating evidence and does not certify IED clock quality.
Physical R7/R10 interoperability qualification and SCL/IID parity remain incomplete for the pinned ARIEC61850 trial engine; no universal device certification is implied.
Manual PurgeBuf destroys retained IED history. Use it only on an authorized, idle test BRCB after reviewing the consequences; ARSAS never runs it automatically.
Windows x64 installers are not Authenticode-signed; verify the published SHA-256. Raw GOOSE/SV capture needs approved Npcap, and control operations require an authorized procedure.
knownLimitationsId: Trace SG7_BCU juga mencatat 4 indikasi BufOvfl dan 28 diskontinuitas SqNum. Ini bukan jumlah event yang terbukti hilang; SOE buffer tanpa kehilangan belum terverifikasi.
MMS BinaryTime 6-byte tidak membawa byte kualitas sinkronisasi clock. Klasifikasi buffer memakai bukti gabungan dan bukan sertifikasi kualitas jam IED.
Kualifikasi interoperabilitas fisik R7/R10 dan paritas SCL/IID untuk engine ARIEC61850 trial yang dipin masih belum lengkap; tidak ada klaim sertifikasi semua perangkat.
PurgeBuf manual menghapus riwayat IED yang tersimpan. Gunakan hanya pada BRCB uji yang idle dan berizin setelah memahami akibatnya; ARSAS tidak pernah menjalankannya otomatis.
Installer Windows x64 belum memiliki tanda tangan Authenticode; verifikasi SHA-256. Capture GOOSE/SV memerlukan Npcap yang disetujui dan operasi control harus mengikuti prosedur berizin.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
